label: From setup to a checked change
disclosure: Setup instructions followed by a visual summary of an actual Codex CLI session. The agent was prompted to use Typelatch and worked in a prepared exercise. Animation timing is edited for readability. This single session does not measure comparative performance, token savings or time saved.

source.packageSource: Built development checkout, not a registry installation

scenes.title: Connect your agent
scenes.body: Run setup, choose your client and confirm. Prepare your dependency APIs, then start a new session in your project.
scenes.code:
$ npx typelatch@0.3.0 setup

Choose Codex or Claude Code and confirm
$ npx typelatch@0.3.0 sync

Start a new client session in your project
scenes.caption: Setup instructions. The recorded session used a prepared source checkout.

evidence.preparation: The capture harness prepared exact dependency indexes before the agent started.

scenes.title: Ask about the problem
scenes.body: One source search returns the implementation, its tests and package configuration. No file or package name was supplied.
